caseNameFull: Keefe v. Martin Drain and Branches Drain District
attorneys: Messrs. Raymond K. Dykema and David M. Wood for petitioners. Messrs. Alex. J. Groes-beck and Bert V. Nunneley for respondents. Mr. Joseph W. Hutchinson filed a brief on behalf of the Board of Trustees of the Indiana State Teachers’ Retirement Fund, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.
